name: Needle
overview: The Scriptures teach through the metaphor of a camel passing through the eye of a needle the profound difficulty for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God, emphasizing the spiritual challenge wealth can pose to salvation. This imagery, found in Matthew 19:24, Mark 10:25, and Luke 18:25, highlights the necessity of humility and dependence on God's grace rather than earthly riches. The teaching calls believers to examine their hearts and priorities in light of eternal values.
